Refactored `Simulator` to construct its core components through an injectable factory instead of hardcoding `Field` and `FieldEntityController`.

The new abstraction is [SimulationComponentFactory.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulationComponentFactory.java:1), which defines how to create the `FieldEnvironment`, `EntityController`, `Climate`, and `FieldPopulator`. `Simulator` now has a constructor that accepts a `SimulationComponentFactory`, and its existing constructors delegate to that using the default implementation. The hardcoded `new Field(...)` and `new FieldEntityController(...)` calls are gone; construction now happens through the factory in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Simulator.java:54). This makes it straightforward to inject test doubles or alternate implementations for the field/controller path.
